relic_backstep.png:
A single game item icon, one object only, centred, drawn as flat cartoon art.

The object: a small drawstring belt pouch of soft plum-purple cloth, its mouth open at the top, with three slim
bamboo-tubed sewing needles standing up out of it in a fan. The needle tips are tipped with a blob of
SICKLY YELLOW-GREEN poison, and one small curl of the same yellow-green vapour rises from the tips.
The pouch is the big bold shape; the needles are the second read.

It is shown at about 40 pixels across in the game, so it must read from its silhouette and its main colour alone:
one bold shape, high contrast, no fine detail, no small parts.
Draw it SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour with a little soft shading. Nothing transparent or see-through.
Nothing else in the picture: no hand, no character, no ground, no shadow, no text, no letters, no watermark.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors, cute cartoon look, not photorealistic.
The green background must stay pure green everywhere it shows. Do NOT paint a rectangular picture, panel, card,
frame, inset or coloured backdrop on top of the green. The poison vapour is part of the object: draw it as a free
shape with an irregular wispy outline, never as a block with straight edges or square corners.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green in the object
except the poison itself, which must be a YELLOW-green (not pure green) so the chroma key does not eat it.
Output 512x512 PNG. Save the image as relic_backstep.png in the current directory and report the path.
